messages:
mike: Heads up — CI started failing nightly SAST on `keystore/keystore.go` after an RBAC tweak. Build 5912. Scanner error says it can't decrypt artifacts. Anyone on call?
scan-bot: scan-bot: nightly-sast run 5912 failed for `keystore` - error: KMS AccessDenied. Details: https://ci.internal/runs/5912
riyad: I made an RBAC tighten last night (service account policy). Could be related, will check.
laura: Noted. Can you paste the scanner log snippet?
mike: ```
ERR: failed to decrypt artifact: AccessDeniedException: User "serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" does not have permission to decrypt key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/keystore-prod
Stack: kms:Decrypt -> storage:GetObject -> scanner:fetchArtifact
```
sara: If KMS decrypt fails the scanner falls back to file heuristics and you see noisy/false positives. We also saw a DAST auth test 401 on staging earlier. @oncall-ryan can you apply an ephemeral grant for `scanner-sa` (kms:Decrypt) for 30m and re-run the job?
oncall-ryan: Granting now. CLI snippet: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding keystore-prod --member=serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --condition='expression=request.time < timestamp("2026-03-21T12:10:00Z")'` — applying short-lived binding, will kick the job afterwards.
riyad: Thanks — long-term we should prefer workload identity to let the scanner assume a dedicated scanner-sa instead of relying on deployer service accounts. I'll open a PR to change the scanner runner.
laura: :thumbsup: Given DAST auth failures this could block a release, treating as P1 until re-run completes.
oncall-ryan: Grant applied. Re-run started: https://ci.internal/runs/5913
scan-bot: scan-bot: run 5913 completed. SAST results: decrypt errors cleared, 4 fewer findings in `keystore/`, remaining findings marked `needs-review`.
mike: Good. Action items: 1) reconcile the RBAC change (either revert or scope it), 2) update scanning pipeline to explicitly use scanner-sa via workload identity. @riyad can you take #2? I'll document incident.
riyad: Taking #2. I'll PR today and add a pre-check to fail fast if KMS decrypt doesn't succeed (so CI blocks earlier).
laura: Also add an audit-log tag to IAM changes so we can correlate scan failures with recent perms edits.
sara: Agree. I'll update the runbook: "If scanner KMS decrypt fails -> check recent IAM changes, request ephemeral grant, rerun, and open PR for permanent fix."
mike: Filed incident INC-2026-118 and linked the CI runs. Will close this thread after the PR lands. https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-118
